_documentation.purpose: Preset bouquet prices by number of pieces, by size, or as a single fixed price.
conventions: Top level is an object with two keys: `_documentation` (this block, ignored by the app) and `items` (the array of records the app reads).
Prices are in Philippine pesos (PHP), stored as plain numbers with no currency symbol.
`null` means the value is not known yet. It never means zero. Check for null before doing math on a value.
Enumerated values (type, origin, occasion, mood, etc.) are lowercase, with hyphens instead of spaces where noted.
`id` values are unique and stable. Gaps in the numbering are fine, and ids should not be reused or renumbered.
`image` paths are served from the site root, so `/images/flowers/x.png` means the file `public/images/flowers/x.png`. The image files themselves have not been added yet.

fields.name: string. Display name.
fields.tierType: string. `pcs` if tiers are by piece count, `size` if tiers are by size label, `fixed` if the bouquet has one price only.
fields.tiers: array. Each tier is {pcs, price} when tierType is `pcs` (1, 3, 6, 12, 24, 36 pieces; a bouquet may offer only some of these), {size, price} when tierType is `size` (extra small, small, medium, large), or a single {price} when tierType is `fixed`.
fields.active: boolean. `false` hides the item from the app (unfinished entries or placeholders). Inactive items stay in the file.
fields.description: string. Free text, may be empty. Use it to say what is included (for example, a stuffed toy).
fields.type: array of strings or null. Only set for bouquets made of non-fresh flowers. Allowed values: preserved, artificial, dried. Null for all other bouquets. Bouquet-012 is one product that can be made with any of the three, so it lists all three.

notes: Tier prices are for the finished preset bouquet. They are separate from the per-stem prices in flowers.json, which are used when a customer designs their own bouquet.
African and Indian are assumed to be rose varieties.
Fixed-price bouquets have exactly one tier, {price}. The number of pieces is not recorded for them.
Single Rose (Fresh) and Single Rose (Wooden) are assumed to be two separate products at the same price, 150 each, in a simple wrap.
The preserved/artificial/dried bouquet is one product at 3000 that includes a stuffed toy. The toy size is not recorded and is not linked to addons.json.

items.name: Single Rose (Fresh)
items.description: A single fresh rose in a simple wrap.

items.name: Single Rose (Wooden)
items.description: A single wooden rose in a simple wrap.
